annotations.title: Compare UK fresh dog food costs

description: Ongoing cost per day, per month and for the first year of every UK fresh and subscription dog food brand BowlPrice tracks, for one dog, ranked cheapest first. Figures come from BowlPrice's sampling of each brand's own quote process, with the date they were last verified and links to BowlPrice's page for each brand.

activity.description: low: mostly resting; normal: typical daily walks; high: very active or working.

ageBand.description: puppy: under 1 year; adult: 1 to 7 years; senior: 8 years and over.

neutered.description: Whether the dog is neutered or spayed.

weightKg.description: The dog's bodyweight in kilograms, 2 to 60. Rounded to the nearest half kilo.
